verdicts.note: The policy requires verifying the account PIN against the PIN on the account before any pass is added or request opened, refusing if it does not match or is missing.
The policy states to add the catalog price to current balance due and if the result is more than the account credit limit (with equal allowed), open a credit review with reason over_credit_limit.
The policy requires date of birth to match exactly on file, otherwise do not set up a plan.
The policy states the supply must be active and disconnected/closed accounts cannot get an arrangement.
The policy states if the account shows two or more payment plans broken in the last 12 months, decline.
The policy requires between 2 and 12 monthly instalments and states fewer than 2 or more than 12 are declined.
The policy requires overdue balance to not be less than 25.00 times the requested instalments.
The policy requires date of birth verification against the member's record on file before filing; failing or missing it means not filing.
The policy specifies the claim's current status must be denied, and to refuse if it is not.
The policy explicitly allows exactly 180 days and disallows 181 days or more from the claim's decision date.
The policy states a claim can be appealed at most twice and refuses if it already has two prior appeals.
The policy states the emergency_care basis can only be used when the place of service is an emergency room, refusing otherwise.
The policy requires the caller's date of birth to match the profile before any change, declining/making no change if it doesn't match or cannot be provided.
The policy instructs to decline if fare is Basic, if the route (origin/destination) differs, or if seats available is 0 (< 1).
The policy specifies opening a revenue desk review with reason 'fare_difference' when the new flight fare is more than 150.00 higher than the current flight fare.
The policy requires the reservation to be confirmed and not yet checked in, completed, or cancelled, matching res.status == 'confirmed'.
The policy requires the request to be at least 2 days before check-in, noting that check-in tomorrow or today must be declined, matching days_between(today, res.check_in) < 2.

The policy specifies standard < deluxe < suite, stating that suites cannot be upgraded and requesting the same room type is not allowed. Since only deluxe and suite can be requested, this matches res.room_type == 'suite' or res.room_type == req.target_room_type.
The policy requires sufficient points for the stay at 5,000/night for deluxe or 12,000/night for suite multiplied by the nights (check-out minus check-in), refusing if the balance is too low.
The policy requires the rental status to be active, declining any returned, cancelled, or inactive rental.
The policy requires that the account must not be blocked.
The policy requires declining if the renter has an outstanding balance above 0.00.
The policy specifies extensions must be between 1 and 14 days, declining any requests outside this range.
The policy declines extensions if the rental has already been extended twice.
The policy sends requests where total duration exceeds 30 days for manager approval with reason long_term.

The policy requires the enrollment to currently be in registered status, stating already withdrawn or completed enrollments cannot be withdrawn, which precisely matches enr.status != 'registered' leading to refusal.

The policy requires today to be on or before the withdrawal deadline (including the deadline itself) and refuses withdrawals after the deadline, matching days_between(sec.withdraw_deadline, today) > 0 leading to refusal.
The policy requires verifying the permit holder's registered address postcode against records; if it doesn't match or cannot be provided, do not renew.
The policy states that only an active permit can be renewed, and expired or revoked permits cannot be renewed.
The policy clearly states that owing more than 50.00 blocks renewal, while 50.00 or less allows renewal.
The policy restricts renewals to the 45 days before expiry (refusing if more than 45 days away) and only permits terms of 6 or 12 months.
The policy requires the membership to be active and declines already frozen, suspended, or cancelled memberships.
The policy specifies the membership must have no outstanding balance and declines if any amount is due.
The policy specifies freezes must be at least 7 days and at most 90 days, declining outside this range.
The policy limits freezes to at most twice per calendar year, declining if two have already been used this year.
The policy declines if the contract ends in fewer than 30 days from today.
The policy directs medical reasons or freezes longer than 60 days to freeze review with the specified arguments.
Checks active status and expiry date on or after today (expiry_date < today -> refuse).
Requires refills_remaining >= 1 and req.days_supply <= rx.max_days_supply, declining otherwise.
Requires at least 75% of previous days' supply to have passed since last fill date.
Controlled substance refills create a pharmacist review with reason 'controlled_substance' and requested days' supply.
Requires the account to be active; suspended/closed accounts are refused.
Requires the outage ticket to be resolved, otherwise refused.
Refuses if the ticket is already marked as credited.
Refuses outages caused by customer-owned equipment or announced scheduled maintenance.
Requires request to be within 60 days after service was restored (ticket end date), otherwise refused.
For 5 or more days out, opens a supervisor review request with reason extended_outage.
The policy requires the caller to provide the shipping postcode matching the order records, declining if it does not match or cannot be provided.
The policy states the order status must be delivered, and other statuses cannot be exchanged.
The policy requires the request to be within 30 days of the delivery date in the system (30 days or fewer is fine, matching > 30 refuse).
The policy explicitly disallows final sale items and items that have already had an exchange recorded (exchange_status != 'none').
The policy requires the replacement to have the same product_id and at least one unit in stock.
Matches all conditions for declining: order not delivered, delivered > 3 days ago, requested amount > order total, or order already refunded/under review.
Matches review condition: amount > 25 (with reason 'high_amount') or >= 3 refunds in the last 90 days (with reason 'frequent_refunds').
The policy requires the caller to provide the postcode matching the delivery postcode on the parcel record; if it doesn't match or cannot be given, do not reschedule.
The policy states the parcel must be in transit or at the depot, explicitly excluding other statuses.
The policy requires the new date to be later than the scheduled date on record and at most 7 days after it, explicitly declining dates outside this window.
The identity check requires matching the date of birth on file, refusing (no deferral and no review) if missing or mismatched.
Reviews are triggered if days > 10 or late payments in the last 12 months >= 2, with matching reason logic and arguments.
Identity check requires date of birth to match the employee record before booking, refusing otherwise.
Only active employees can book, refusing if employment status is not active.
Start date must be at least 14 calendar days after today, refusing if sooner.
Booking covers at most 10 working days, refusing longer requests.
Requested days cannot exceed the employee's paid time off balance.
The policy requires the card to be open and states frozen or closed cards cannot have their limit raised, declining otherwise.
The policy requires the card to be current and to decline if past due by even one day, matching days_past_due > 0.
The policy requires the new limit to be higher than the current limit, no more than 50% above it, and at least 180 days since the last limit change, declining if any condition fails.
Declines if policy status is not active (only active policies allowed).
Declines if open claims > 0.
Declines lowering deductible if pet is 8 years old or older (2922 days = 8 * 365 + 2 leap days).
Identity check requires date of birth to match the owner on file; failure leads to refuse (no change).
Cancelled registrations cannot be renewed and are declined.
Declines renewal if unpaid fines > 50.00.
Declines renewal if requested term is not 1 or 2 years.
Opens compliance review with reason emissions_overdue if emissions test > 730 days ago.
Only active memberships can be paused; all other statuses are declined.
Any balance due above 0.00 declines the pause.
Decline requests outside the range of 2 to 8 whole weeks inclusive.
Decline if pauses used this year is 2 or more (at most twice per calendar year).
Decline if membership started less than 90 days ago.
Create pause approval request with space operations for dedicated desk and private office plans.
The policy requires verifying the last four digits of the payment card against the order before any refund; if they do not match or cannot be provided, refuse.
The policy requires the order to still be confirmed and notes that orders already refunded or transferred cannot be refunded.
The policy requires the event to be cancelled or postponed, or that the order has refund protection and the event status is still on sale.
Identity check matches R1 and refuses on failure/missing DOB.
Requires status to be currently booked, otherwise no refund/cancellation.
Requires appointment to be at least 2 days away (today and tomorrow excluded), matching days_between < 2 -> refuse.
Opens coordinator review with reason 'lab_work_ordered' if lab work has been ordered, without cancelling or refunding.
The policy requires declining if the account's last leak adjustment was granted less than 365 days ago, exactly matching account.last_leak_adjustment > add_days(today, -365).
The policy requires declining if the bill's usage is less than twice the typical usage, exactly matching bill.usage_kgal < 2 * bill.typical_usage_kgal.
Checks invoice status is 'paid', declining unpaid, refunded, or disputed invoices.
Declines if past-due balance is more than 0.00.
Declines if older than 30 days from invoice date; exactly 30 days qualifies.
Declines accidental_renewal if invoice kind is not renewal.
Declines if active_days_after_charge > 5 and reason is not duplicate_charge.
Opens billing review with reason high_value if amount > 1000 and preceding checks pass.
